APPROVE
`Read` and every extracted method now sit well under 15, the control flow and state transitions are preserved, and the helpers are static members reachable from the nested `Reader`; the only unverifiable change is that `TopLevel` now uses `IsDependencySection(_top)` instead of the explicit three-name pattern, which keeps behaviour only if that helper (truncated in the diff, and the source isn't on this machine) tests exactly `dependencies`/`devDependencies`/`optionalDependencies`.
